# The Wager

*Percy and Gareth have a wager on what has been gouging the wheels on the Royal Road. Bring Percy 15 Curved Tusks from the Boarwood's boars, and let Gareth look at one first.*

|---|---|

## Objectives

1. Bring 15 [Curved Tusk](../items/curved_tusk.md) (taken)
2. Talk to [Gareth](../npcs/gareth.md)

## Rewards

- 7,000 EXP
- 3,000 mesos
- [Elixir](../items/elixir.md) x2
- One of: [Blue Sergeant](../items/blue_sergeant.md), [Steel Sergeant Kilt](../items/steel_sergeant_kilt.md), [Venon](../items/venon_gloves.md)
- +30 standing with Kaldemor

    - *Player*. Look at this felloe. Curved gouges, as if something closed on the rim and pulled. Half the wheels off the Royal Road come in like it this year, and one iron tyre bent inward. Pell's cab came in with two spokes cracked through.
    - Gareth and I have a wager on what does it. I will not tell you my guess, and he will not tell you his. But you have been in those woods past the stile. You have seen what lives there now.

    - Lay that against one of Percy's gouges and it will sit in it like a key in a lock. Now I know what a blade must cut, *Player*. I have been forging for the wrong thing all spring.
